questions.questionText: Example 3.1: An element reacts with oxygen to give a compound with a high melting point.
questions.solutionText: The element is Calcium (Ca). Calcium reacts with oxygen to form calcium oxide (CaO) which is ionic and soluble in water.

questions.questionText: Example 3.2: Why is sodium kept immersed in kerosene oil?
questions.solutionText: Sodium is a highly reactive metal. It reacts vigorously with atmospheric oxygen and moisture. To prevent accidental fires, it is stored in kerosene.

questions.questionText: Example 3.3: Which of the following metals does not react with oxygen even at high temperatures?
questions.solutionText: Gold and Silver do not react with oxygen even at high temperatures because of their very low reactivity.
